title.en: Match the SmartPay3 administrator flow to SmartMeeting
title.zh: 统一 SmartPay3 管理流程并对齐 SmartMeeting

purpose.en: Restore the canonical Contract-and-Owner-first SmartPay3 administrator page while keeping payment-product editing in the administrator dashboard.
purpose.zh: 恢复以合约与 Owner 为首屏的标准 SmartPay3 管理页，并把付款产品编辑保留在管理员面板。

en: Show contract deployment/import and the connected Owner wallet before every other SmartPay3 control.
Keep payment-product configuration available in the administrator dashboard without duplicating it on the crypto administration route.
zh: 在所有其他 SmartPay3 控件之前显示合约部署/导入及已连接的 Owner 钱包。
付款产品配置继续位于管理员面板，不再重复显示于加密付款管理路由。

en: Administrator crypto-payments page, administrator dashboard, and the SmartPay3 Owner-wallet contract test.
zh: 管理员加密付款页、管理员面板及 SmartPay3 Owner 钱包契约测试。

en: Remove the product-settings card from the crypto route, mount it in the dashboard, and assert that connecting an EVM wallet fills the Owner/deployer address.
zh: 从加密付款路由移除产品设置卡并挂载到管理员面板，同时断言连接 EVM 钱包会填入 Owner/部署钱包地址。

en: Pass the complete repository test suite, production vinext build, shared site-policy gates, architecture audit, and base-feature consistency audit.
zh: 通过完整仓库测试、生产 vinext 构建、共享站点政策检查、架构审计及基础功能一致性审计。

en: No SmartPay3 contract is deployed and no on-chain transaction is submitted by this release; wallet approval remains an explicit administrator action.
zh: 本次发布不会部署 SmartPay3 合约或提交链上交易；钱包授权仍由管理员明确确认。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, language-learning behavior, and this site's independent identity, user, payment, and data boundaries.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、language-learning 业务行为，以及本站独立的身份、用户、支付与数据边界。
